item.tib: pom ra'i 'khor lo bri thabs dngos grub char 'bebs yid bzhin 'od 'bar
item.coloph: ces pa 'khor lo yid bzhin 'od 'bar 'di ni dus snyigs ma'i kho bo 'gru btsun a yu kir ti 'bod pa bdag gis thar bde mi g.yo bsam gtan gling gi kun bzang 'od gsal drug zur rnam rgyal khang du bgyis pas/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya cher 'byung ba'i rgyu ru gyur cig/

item.tib: spyi khyab nam mkha' yangs pa'i mdzod las dbal chen me phreng chen po'i thugs sgrub bdud 'joms gsang ba'i snying po
item.coloph: zhes snyigs ma'i kho bo 'jig med g.yung drung mi 'gyur grags pa rgyal mtshan nam hUM chen 'gro 'dul gling pa'i gtan la phab ste yi ge pa ni spangs lam pa rin chen bkra shis gyis bgyis pas bon 'di stong khams khyab pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
